first_audio_url.title: First Audio URL
first_audio_url.description: The URL of the Person 1 audio file.

use_only_first_audio.title: Use Only First Audio
use_only_first_audio.description: Whether to use only the first audio file.

num_frames.title: Number of Frames
num_frames.description: Number of frames to generate. Must be between 81 to 129 (inclusive). If the number of frames is greater than 81, the video will be generated with 1.25x more billing units.

second_audio_url.title: Second Audio URL
second_audio_url.description: The URL of the Person 2 audio file.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The text prompt to guide video generation.

acceleration.title: Acceleration
acceleration.description: The acceleration level to use for generation.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. If None, a random seed is chosen.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Resolution of the video to generate. Must be either 480p or 720p.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.

image_url.title: Image URL
image_url.description: URL of the input image. If the input image does not match the chosen aspect ratio, it is resized and center cropped.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
